formal_statement: ∀ (m n k : ℕ) (y : Fin m × Fin m → ℂ), MvPolynomial.eval y (PEqualNP.Gct.permPoly ℂ m) = 0 → (∀ L : Submodule ℂ (Fin m × Fin m → ℂ), (∀ t ∈ L, MvPolynomial.eval (y + t) (PEqualNP.Gct.permPoly ℂ m) = 0) → Module.finrank ℂ L ≤ k) → PEqualNP.Gct.HasDetExpression (PEqualNP.Gct.permPoly ℂ m) n → m ^ 2 ≤ k + n
plain_statement: If y is a zero of perm_m and every linear space L with y+L inside {perm_m = 0} has dim at most k, then every determinantal expression of perm_m has size n >= m^2 - k. Proof: A(y)u = 0 gives L = {t : (sum t_ij A_ij)u = 0}, codim <= n. Folklore form of the linear-space method (cf. von zur Gathen 1987, Alper-Bogart-Velasco 2017).
title: Subspace reduction: dc(perm_m) >= m^2 - k when some zero y of perm_m has no linear space of dim > k through it inside the hypersurface
